title: Solvent: Long-Horizon Reasoning for Multi-Step Retrosynthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.32308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis requires recursively transforming a target molecule through successive reaction steps into purchasable building blocks, and recent work has begun to draw on large language model (LLM) reasoning to tackle the task. In its latest evolution, LLM reasoning has entered the long-horizon regime: models pursue objectives across interdependent steps, interact with environments, and adapt to feedback. This shift has markedly advanced LLM capabilities, as illustrated by breakthroughs in AI-driven mathematical research. At this frontier, we introduce Solvent, an 8B LLM that successfully extends long-horizon reasoning to multi-step retrosynthesis. Through a two-round post-training curriculum, Solvent learns to interleave iterative synthesis planning, external availability verification, and adaptive route revision. translated_title: Solvent：面向多步逆合成的长程推理
translated_abstract: 多步逆合成需要通过连续的反应步骤递归地将目标分子转化为可购买的构建模块，近期的研究已开始借助大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力来解决这一任务。在其最新的演进中，LLM推理已进入长程推理阶段：模型在相互依赖的多个步骤中追求目标、与环境交互并适应反馈。这一转变显著提升了LLM的能力，AI驱动的数学研究中的突破即是例证。在这一前沿方向上，我们推出了Solvent——一个8B参数的LLM，它成功地将长程推理扩展到了多步逆合成任务。通过两轮后训练课程，Solvent学会了交错执行迭代式合成规划、外部可得性验证以及自适应路线修正。实验表明，在强化学习带来2.1倍性能提升后，Solvent在四个基准上取得了61.86%的成绩。
tldr: Solvent是一个8B参数的大语言模型，通过两轮后训练课程与强化学习将长程推理能力引入多步逆合成任务，学会交错执行迭代合成规划、外部可得性验证和自适应路线修正，性能提升2.1倍后在四个基准上取得61.86%的成绩。
en_tdlr: Solvent is an 8B LLM that successfully extends long-horizon reasoning to multi-step retrosynthesis through a two-round post-training curriculum, learning to interleave iterative synthesis planning, external availability verification, and adaptive route revision, achieving 61.86% across four benchmarks after a 2.1× RL-driven performance boost.
